history.content: Hi, my phone has no service at all—no bars, nothing loads, and I can't send picture messages. Can you help?
I can help you with this issue. To get started, I need to identify your account. Could you please provide either your phone number, customer ID, or your full name along with your date of birth?
My name is Sofia Martinez and my phone number is +1-617-555-0148.

Thank you for providing your information. Since your line is active but you have no service (no bars, nothing loads, and you can't send picture messages), let's start troubleshooting:

1. Is Airplane Mode turned on?
2. Is your SIM card properly recognized?
3. Are your network and APN settings correct?

I’ll guide you through some quick checks and fixes. Are you able to access your phone’s settings right now so we can proceed step by step?
Yes, I can access my phone’s settings. What should I check first?

Great! Let’s start by checking if Airplane Mode is enabled, as this will block all service.

Please check your phone’s status bar (the area at the top of your screen) and let me know if you see an airplane icon, or if it says “Airplane Mode.” If you’re not sure, I can guide you through a quick check—just let me know!
Actually, I do see an airplane icon in the status bar and it says Airplane Mode is on. What should I do next?

Airplane Mode disables all wireless connections, including your cellular service. To restore service, please turn Airplane Mode off in your phone’s settings or by tapping the airplane icon in your quick settings menu.

Once you’ve turned Airplane Mode off, check if your service returns (look for signal bars in the status bar). Let me know if you see any signal or if the issue persists.
Airplane mode is now off, and I see signal bars again. Should I try sending a picture message to make sure everything is working?

Yes, please try sending a picture message now to confirm that MMS (picture messaging) is working. If the message sends successfully, your service should be fully restored. If you encounter any issues sending the picture message, let me know and I’ll help you troubleshoot further.
The picture message sent successfully and the messaging app can send MMS messages. My signal bars are back too, so it looks like service has been restored.

That’s excellent news! Turning off Airplane Mode restored your cellular service and MMS functionality. If you experience any other issues or have questions about your service, feel free to reach out. Have a great day!
